claim_text: Among 18 evaluable children with NF1 plexiform neurofibroma-related motor dysfunction, 14 (78%) improved muscle strength by manual muscle testing after 12 cycles of selumetinib, with a median increase of 4.8% in total strength score.
notes: Full text (PMC7305659). Single-arm phase 2 (n=50, stratum 1 only), unblinded central MRI volumetry; capped at 3 because there is no randomized control (RCT/strength 4 criteria not met). Outcome measures other than Pain Interference Index and visual acuity are not validated in NF1 (per authors); uncontrolled, unblinded patient-reported outcomes. Small subgroup. | Grounded by Otto via RTX-KG2c PloverDB + SRI Node Normalizer, accessed 2026-11-18. Motor dysfunction outcome. HP:0001324 (Muscle weakness) added as related phenotype.
source_title: Selumetinib in Children with Inoperable Plexiform Neurofibromas
